```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Saint Marks' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Georgia'
  LIMIT 1
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, rg.geom, TRUE) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us r, region_geom rg
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, rg.geom)
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(clipped_dem.rast, 1, '32BF', TRUE) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT MAX(ST_Value(slope_raster.rast, 1)) AS max_slope_degrees
FROM slope_raster;
```
